Red Giant Tomatoes - Plug Plants - 2x - Giant Wilt Resistant Tomato - Up to 1kg
Red Giant Tomato Plug Plants - Mid-Early Indeterminate Variety 

 Red Giant is a mid-early indeterminate tomato, valued for its early yield and long growing season (120-125 days). Plants produce large, round, ribbed fruits with a deep red color and a meaty texture. Each tomato can weigh between 500g and 1000g, making them perfect for fresh eating, canning, or market use. 

 These plug plants are suitable for both outdoor and greenhouse growing. They are easy to care for, though some support is recommended due to the size of the fruit. Red Giant produces abundant crops, and the ripe fruit is slightly softer, enhancing its sweet, rich flavor. 

 Plants are resistant to tobacco mosaic virus (Tm), Verticillium (V), and Fusarium (F 1,2). For best results, plant in well-drained soil in a sunny spot. Red Giant plug plants are an excellent choice for gardeners seeking reliable, great-tasting, and impressive tomatoes.
